$comment: The source of sf-segmented's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/button-group (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs from simai/ui-source@5100227 src/smart/button-group/smart.manifest.json); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Its x-todo are decided in x-decisions.

lang.summary: The language the label is written in (BCP 47); the segment carries it as lang, so a screen reader reads «Deutsch» in German.

items.x-shape: ui-source src/smart/button-group/index.js normalizeItems: the attribute takes JSON or value::label::flags|…, the property a list; aria-label of an entry names an icon-only item
items.summary: Selectable items with stable value, label, lang, icon, count, icon-only, disabled and loading fields.

name.summary: Native form field name: the group submits its value with its form, a form reset restores the initial value, and a disabled group is left out.

theme-switch.summary: A ready theme switch: the group draws its own three icon-only items (system, light, dark) named in the page language, selects SF.Loader's theme preference and follows sf-theme-change, and a choice calls SF.Loader.setTheme. items is ignored.

scheme.summary: Colour scheme for the selected button of the buttons look, and for the plate on the track when plate is scheme.

appearance.summary: How the control looks (owner decision D11c). track, the default: a translucent track with a plate under the selected option. buttons: joined outlined buttons, the selected one filled -- for forms and toolbars on a plain surface, next to other buttons. The selection model, keyboard and events are the same. The old values segmented and default are dated aliases of track and buttons.

plate.summary: The plate under the selected option on the track. raised, the default: a neutral raised surface with its shadow (white in the light theme). scheme: the scheme's fill, an accent for the one switch on a screen that needs it.

backdrop.summary: What the track stands on. surface, the default: a page, a card or a panel; the track is the surface container fill. color: a coloured place (a brand header, a coloured banner); the track and the labels take the place's ink (currentColor), so they read on any colour. media: a photo or a video; the track is a dark glass (black 48% with a blur) with white labels and a white plate, the same in both themes.

full-width.summary: On the track, the control fills its container and the options share the width equally.

radius.summary: Corner radius, as on sf-button: empty is the UI radius. On the track the plate, a button-sized option, takes the radius a button of that value has, and the track is it plus the padding (rounded: both pills).

item.summary: The selected item; null after clear().

change.summary: The selected value changed through select() or clear(); dispatched on the host, bubbles and is composed. The name to bind.

select.summary: Selects an enabled item by value.

relations.name: spinner
$comment: spinner: a loading item shows it, fetched after the page is ready.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §16.20). Event rows send the new name first, then the old one, with one detail; setting rows map the old attribute and property to the new; host-attribute rows (no "to") stay host attributes read by the browser or the base and are listed, refused by the shim on purpose; documentary rows ("shim": "none") record a rename the shim cannot serve.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
sent by the shim after change, with the same detail; the detail no longer carries the element (§8)
rows.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

rows.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
rows.note: the element is sf-segmented; sf-button-group is a subclass defined beside it until the date
owner decision D11b/D11c (docs review R035, R037): the two looks are named track and buttons; track is the default
owner decision D11b/D11c (docs review R035, R037): the two looks are named track and buttons; track is the default

x-summary: A controlled single-selection group built from SF5 buttons.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
events.change: 1 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
x-decisions: version: 1.1.0 -- sf-button-group-change follows change behind a dated alias, and the element leaves the change detail (§8); a minor while the alias holds (§4.10)
template: the default template stays the Lit module js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; template.html follows when the build compiles HTML templates
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json
css-variables: the seven public variables the group already had (2026-10-19), now declared in the manifest
item-shape: items name id, value, label, icon, count, icon-only, loading and disabled; the attribute keeps its JSON and value::label::flags forms

actions: select {value} and clear answer an outcome (§4.4): applied, or refused with unknown, disabled, unchanged or theme (a Loader that cannot change the theme); chaining is gone. Both are a person's request in code and send change, as before

form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals (§17.1): the selected value, nothing while disabled; form.reset() returns the value the group was written with (a theme switch keeps the preference). The hidden input is drawn only without ElementInternals
accessibility.name: the host's aria-label, or the theme switch's own word «Тема»
version 1.1.1: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (sf-language, owner decision 2026-11-06): an item may name the language its label is written in, lang; the segment (or the sf-button of the default appearance) carries it as lang, so a language picker's «Deutsch» is read in German. Nothing else changes.

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.0: the tag is sf-segmented (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.segmented and the bundle cl-segmented follow it. sf-button-group stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-segmented, sf-button-group) (change journal tag-sf-button-group-to-sf-segmented, path-smart-button-group-to-segmented).

version 1.4.0 (owner decisions D11b, D11c; docs review R035, R037): the default look is the track with a raised neutral plate (appearance track, plate raised); the joined buttons are appearance buttons, for forms on a plain surface. The old appearance values segmented and default are dated value aliases of track and buttons (until 2027-01-01). New setting backdrop: surface (the surface container track, as before), color (track and labels from the place's ink, currentColor at the fill step 12) and media (dark glass: black 48 with a blur, white labels and plate). The plate slides to the chosen option in 0.2 s, and stands still under prefers-reduced-motion. The theme switch's system item draws desktop_windows (a monitor) instead of brightness_auto. The track colour stays the surface container role until the background system (C16) renames the roles.

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The generated reference gives the action's method its one object argument, select({value}), where it read the parameters one by one (standard §4.4: the parameters arrive as one object). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.2 (2026-11-09): the group's spacing reaches its sf-button segments as root-class="spacing-<value>" (the class sheet's spacing class, same drawing) instead of sf-button's spacing, which decision C27 deprecates (journal attribute-button-spacing-to-height): a page that sets spacing on the group gets no sf-button deprecation warning from the Framework's own template. Settings, values and look unchanged.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-button-group for one compact mutually exclusive choice; appearance="segmented" for a filter, period, view or theme switch drawn as a segmented control (not tabs: no panels).
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not persist selection inside the component
Do not use it for independent multi-select actions

accessibility.focus: Use roving tabindex and an inset focus-visible indicator that does not cover adjacent segments.

sf-button-group-change.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

focus.summary: Moves focus to the selected or first enabled item.

icon-only.description: Segmented appearance: show only the icon; the label stays as the visually hidden accessible name. Needs an icon.

loading.description: The item works: it shows the spinner at its icon's size, in place of its icon or over its label (which keeps its place and its name), says aria-busy and is disabled until the flag is cleared.

count.description: Segmented appearance: a number after the label, in tabular numerals; it is part of the segment's accessible name.

root-class.description: Extra classes applied to the group root.
